title: Blit copies into a destination texture left in its sampled state (no transition to COPY_DEST)
expected_finding: vkCmdCopyImage writes blit_destination as TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL while the image is in SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL (submitBlit never transitions the const destination); there is also no dependency between the previous frame's fragment-shader reads of blit_destination and the copy's write (write-after-read), nor between the copy and this frame's sampling (read-after-write)
